newsitem.title: USA: Merrill CEO sees tough Q2 and Q3 comparison.
newsitem.headline: Merrill CEO sees tough Q2 and Q3 comparison.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co Inc's new Chairman and Chief Executive Officer David Komansky said on Tuesday last year's second quarter and third quarter results provide a "difficult comparison" for this year's second and third quarter results.
Komansky speaking to reporters after the company's annual meeting said a correction in the markets is healthy and re-establishes a bedrock for stock prices.
"I couldn't be more optimistic about our company's prospects," Komansky said.
In last year's second quarter, Merrill Lynch reported earnings per share of $2.19.

Herb Allison, Merrill Lynch's new President and Chief Operating Officer, said the company is not in a position to give second quarter earnings estimates, but the company's underwriting calendar is half of what it was at this time last year.
Allison said the calendar activity is likely to increase when Washington resolves its budget and tax picture and when the future about interest rates becomes clearer.
